title: Multiple Choice – Word Families
description: Choose the correct word to complete each sentence.

questions.text: The whole school gathered on the sports field to __________ the victory of the soccer team.
Villagers __________ wear embroidered silk tunics during the annual autumn harvest ceremony.
Historians confirmed that the manuscript was an __________ copy written by hand in the fourteenth century.
Wearing uniform vests helped festival volunteers __________ each other easily in the crowded park.
Her grandmother was an __________ cultural mentor who taught many young girls traditional embroidery.
The village council presented a wooden plaque to show their deep __________ for his voluntary service.
Japanese matcha tea has become increasingly __________ among high school students in recent years.
Some culinary chefs choose to __________ in preparing authentic regional seafood delicacies.
In this highland region, it is __________ for hosts to offer hot ginger tea to newly arrived guests.
The orchestra played several lively __________ tunes as the festival parade marched through the main square.
